subject: Reschedule: Redwood demo - budget cycle & travel conflicts
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request to move next week's demo (budget timing)

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for scheduling the Redwood demo for next Tuesday (7/6). Quick update from our side: our finance team just kicked off an internal spending freeze tied to the end-of-quarter budget refresh. The CFO has asked us to pause any new vendor evaluations that might result in spend before the FY reset on 7/15.

I also have travel that week (on-site with a customer) so I won't be able to attend the live demo. Tom may be able to join, but we wanted to check whether you can move the session to late July.

Attached our internal pre-demo questionnaire and the security/contact points so you can prepare (acme-security-questions.xlsx).

Can you propose two slots after 7/15? Ideally the week of 7/20. If not possible, a recording would work for us.

Appreciate the flexibility — Emma

--
Emma Jones
Head of Analytics, Acme Analytics
emma.jones@acme.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week's demo (budget timing)

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and for sending the security questionnaire. Totally understood on the spend freeze and travel. We can absolutely move the demo.

Two quick asks so we can re-plan:
- Do you want a live demo with Q&A (preferred) or a recorded walkthrough plus a follow-up live Q&A with your team?
- Any constraints on timezones for the week of 7/20? We can offer afternoon PT slots (10am/2pm PT) and later EMEA-friendly times if Tom needs to join.

Proposed live slots after 7/15:
- Tues 7/21, 11:00am PT (2:00pm ET)
- Wed 7/22, 2:00pm PT (5:00pm ET)

If one of those works I can send a calendar invite. If not, happy to coordinate via Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo?date=2026-07-20

We will also prepare a short recording to share in case a portion of your team can't attend live.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <purchasing@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to move next week's demo (budget timing)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Live + recording sounds good. Confirming: our finance lead put an internal freeze through 7/15, and we'd be ready to proceed the week of 7/20.

Tom can do 7/21 at 11am PT but he asked whether the session can be recorded and whether you can share the slides and SOC 2 evidence ahead of time. I attached our security checklist earlier (acme-security-questions.xlsx).

If you could tentatively hold 7/21 11am PT that would be great — I'll confirm after procurement signs off.

Thanks,
Emma

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Reschedule request from Acme - please cover demo and prep collateral

Team — looping you in. Acme put a short spend freeze through 7/15 and wants to move the live demo to the week of 7/20 (likely 7/21 11am PT). Emma asked for slides and SOC2 evidence ahead of time and a recording.

Can one of you take point on the demo on 7/21 and own the recording? If possible please:
- Confirm availability for 7/21 11am PT
- Prepare a 25-min demo focused on latency/cost controls + a 5-min Q&A section
- Share SOC2 summary and the short checklist for security review (I attached the agenda earlier)

Aditya — can you produce a short recording (mp4) if I need to send immediately? Laura — can you update the slide deck with the Acme-specific examples and callouts? David — please prepare a one-page cost estimate for a 6-month pilot (include ded. capacity assumptions).

If we don't have coverage, I can run the session but would prefer to be able to step back — travel the week of 7/19.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Reschedule request from Acme - please cover demo and prep collateral

Marissa / team / Emma — happy to take the demo on 7/21 at 11am PT. I'll update the deck with Acme examples and include a SOC2 summary slide; Aditya — I'll need the recording by 7/15 if we want to send it in advance. David — I'll sync on the cost estimate draft tomorrow.

Emma — I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 7/21 11:00am PT (Google Meet) and upload the deck and SOC2 notes to the meeting. Tentative invite: https://meet.google.com/redwood-acme-0721

If procurement confirms earlier, we can accelerate. Otherwise we'll hold 7/21 and share the recording after for any folks who missed it.

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: updated-redwood-demo-deck-vACME.pdf
